gpu_tip: ~41GB total at 128K context. Qwen3.8's hybrid Gated DeltaNet architecture puts a real KV cache on just 16 of its 64 layers, so an 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060 Ti) plus ~48GB of ordinary DDR5 system RAM covers the rest via llama.cpp's per-layer offloading.
mac_tip: Needs ~41GB — fits a 48GB MacBook Pro (M4 Pro/Max or M5 Pro/Max) comfortably.
